name: raksa-game
description: RAKSA GAME - Raksa Claim: Misi Lindungi Kota

scripts.build: npm -w @raksa/client run build && npm -w @raksa/server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @raksa/server run typecheck && npm -w @raksa/client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:client: tsx --tsconfig client/tsconfig.json --test client/src/game/draft.test.ts client/src/game/hasil.test.ts client/src/game/scenes.test.ts client/src/unity/bridge.test.ts client/src/unity/missionObjects.test.ts
